AC5_zero_production_edits_and_defect_rep.summary: Zero production source code edits made. All 5 identified genuine production defects reported with exact files, line numbers, and symbols through governed coordination. No capital authority or capital pool code was touched.

genuine_production_defects.description: main.py calls undefined symbols 'get_catalog_entry' (lines 1866, 1938, 4901, 5384, 6792, 6949, 7179) and 'ProjectionReadUnavailable' (line 384) without defining or importing them.

CommandAdapterService.__init__ takes publish_event parameter but does not assign self._publish_event = publish_event. Line 1354 references self._publish_event, raising AttributeError.

CapitalService.write('create_rebalance') delegates to authority method 'create_rebalance', which is not implemented on capital authority, causing CapitalAuthorityUnavailable. Per AC5, capital authority / pools cannot be modified without operator approval.

AC6_zero_new_failures_and_verification.summary: Complete base-vs-head verification shows zero regressions (0 worse modules). 34 modules improved, 22 modules remained identical. Total passing tests increased from 554 to 648.
